name: methodology-advisor
description: Recommend a software development methodology (TDD/DDD/BDD/Spec-driven/Kanban etc.) based on project structure, purpose, features, and scale. Pairs with dharness factory: emits a single handoff sentence that can be fed straight into /harness:harness-new. Includes a decision matrix, a 24-item methodology catalog, and a wrapper command that chains advisor → user confirm → dharness.
